## Before/after example and results

Use the same brief and settings where possible. Report all outcomes, not only successful ones.

## Review checklist

- [ ] One narrow change; no unrelated rewrite
- [ ] No private data, credentials or unapproved third-party material
- [ ] Source facts, assumptions and approval status remain distinct
- [ ] Tests actually run are listed, with limits
- [ ] Missing rendering, source access or independent review reported as NOT RUN
- [ ] No guarantee or reliability claim based only on wording
